deploy-bot: [AUTO] Promotion blocked: inference-api chart version mismatch (canary v1.4.2 vs staging v1.5.0). Delta: new values key `server.pathPrefix` added, default '/api/v2'. Change window open for US-east. Action: patch canary values to use '/api' OR pin staging to v1.4.2.

tasha: quick context: v1.5.0 changed pathPrefix default; some customers use absolute /api routes. If we promote without aligning values, external health checks will 404.

ryan: canary is safe to patch. I'll apply a values override in canary to set server.pathPrefix='/api' and run smoke. No schema or DB migration.

megan: product asks to rollforward because v1.5.0 fixes header passthrough for internal auth. But we should be careful.

ryan: patch command:
```bash
helm upgrade inference-api ./charts/inference \
  --namespace canary \
  --reuse-values \
  --set server.pathPrefix=/api \
  --wait --timeout 4m
```

tasha: monitoring set: errors <0.4%, p50 <200ms. Abort if threshold crossed.
